About the Speaking Skills event

Speaking Skills is a Leadership event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission. This event has special eligibility requirements, so check the guidelines with your advisor.

Ten step-by-step lessons for the HOSA Speaking Skills solo event, designed for middle school and secondary members classified under IDEA, built around the 2026–27 topic “Redefine the Standard” and the 105-point rating sheet: eligibility and the IEP Verification and Accommodation Form, understanding the topic with a topic web, choosing one main idea, finding stories and examples, building a speech map, writing openings and closings, notecards and memory helpers, using your voice without a microphone, body language and eye contact and practice, calming strategies and competition day. Written in clear, simple language with templates, checklists and practice scenarios.

Openings and closings, notecards and your voice.
